external.nameCopied: Name copied — paste it into their search box, then bring the address back.
external.linkedIntro: This tournament follows chess-results.com. The arbiter's table is what the public page shows.
external.linkFailed: That link could not be used. Check it is a chess-results.com tournament address.
external.linkedRounds: {count, plural, =1 {1 round mirrored} other {# rounds mirrored}}
external.linkedOverridesNote: While this is linked, the public page shows the arbiter's standings and round pairings, and follows their uploads by itself while the event runs.

registration.title: Public registration
registration.intro: Anyone with the link can sign up. Entries are accepted as they arrive and appear on the roster straight away.
registration.qrLabel: QR code linking to the registration form for {name}
registration.portalUnset: Registration is open, but the public link is not configured on this deployment. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL to the portal's address.
registration.failed: That change could not be saved.
registration.pricingEarly: Early bird fee while it lasts

resetPassword.confirmBody: This sets a new temporary password for {name} and shows it once. The old one stops working immediately, and anyone already signed in on a device stays signed in until they sign out.
resetPassword.doneHint: Copy this now — it is not shown again. Hand it over in person and ask them to change it.
resetPassword.copiedNote: Sign-in ID and password copied — paste them wherever you need.
resetPassword.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the sign-in ID and password above and copy them by hand.

practice.dayCell: {date}: {count, plural, =0 {no activity} one {# activity} other {# activities}}
practice.puzzlesSolved: {count, plural, one {# puzzle solved} other {# puzzles solved}}
practice.gamesPlayed: {count, plural, one {# game played} other {# games played}}
practice.weeklyChartLabel: Puzzles solved, practice minutes and games played per week
practice.historyFailed: Could not load this student's games and puzzles.

invite.sent: Invite sent to {email}. They choose their own password from the link, which works for 7 days.
invite.notDelivered: Email isn't set up on this server, so nothing was sent to {email}. The set-password link was written to the backend log.
invite.failed: The invite to {email} could not be sent. Try Resend invite on the parent's page.
invite.sentWithLogin: Invite sent to {email}, with {name}'s student login. They choose their own password from the link, which works for 7 days.
invite.linkSent: Password link sent to {email}. They choose their own password from it; the link works for 7 days.
